verdict.rationale: Azure RBAC provides fine-grained, least-privilege role assignment (azure-docs-10, azure-docs-11), and Managed Identities/Entra ID app registration let an application (including an agent) obtain scoped tokens without embedding long-lived credentials (azure-docs-12, azure-docs-23). This gives the building blocks for scoped API credentials, but nothing in the pack is agent-specific (e.g., no documented workflow for provisioning an 'AI agent' identity, custom-scoped service principal creation steps, or credential expiry/rotation guidance tailored to autonomous agents), and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of this flow. Missing for 10: agent-specific credential issuance guidance, custom role/scope creation walkthrough, independent verification of least-privilege setup for AI workloads.
